# Befree Inc

> Befree Inc is a Canadian technology company based in Ontario. It owns and operates health-tech products and provides software, cloud, SaaS and AI engineering services for startups and growing businesses in Canada, the US and India.

## Products
- BeFree (https://www.befree.fit/): personalized food and nutrition app with food profiling, product scanning and smart grocery guidance. Live.
- JobPulse (jobpulse.work): in build. No public details yet.

## Services
- Product engineering: MVPs, SaaS, web and mobile apps, APIs.
- Modernization and scale: legacy migration, AWS/GCP cost and performance, DevOps.
- AI integration: LLM/RAG features, document and workflow automation.
- Technology advisory: fractional CTO, architecture review, technical due diligence.

## Founder
Vipan Kumar, Founder and CEO. 15+ years building SaaS and enterprise platforms. https://vipan.me/
